propositions: Per-test git rev-parse HEAD calls in _no_repo_commits autouse fixture consume ~207 runner-seconds (69.1s wall on three workers) across 13,255 tests, projecting ~75s savings when bypassed
The _no_repo_commits guard must preserve exact per-test HEAD-move detection, name the responsible test, honor allow_repo_writes escape, and retain session-wide dirty-tree backstop
Proposed in-process HEAD fingerprint replacement requires safe handling of symbolic loose refs, packed refs, detached HEAD, and linked worktrees with fallback for unreadable metadata

Four surveyed active OSS projects (pytest, pip, poetry, pre-commit) consensus-reject per-test source-checkout VCS subprocess calls but lack consensus on a fidelity-preserving implementation primitive for rebar's stronger checkout-attribution contract

No approved implementation path exists: adding a Git library increases dependency/install risk, hand-parsing all ref/storage formats is unsafe, and removing the per-test attribution guard weakens test coverage
